"""Actual sparse-basis search, with the initial-distance and current-gradient anchors."""

search_tolerances = dict(zero_tol=1e-6,indep_tol=1e-7,span_tol=1e-5)
sparse_basis_by_k, cached_coefficients, coeff_inputs, sparse_search_records = {}, {}, {}, {}
for k,in_col in spanning_by_k.items():
    labels = candidate_labels_by_k[k]
    fixed = [vector for vector in in_col if labels[id(vector)] in ("u",f"g_{k}/L")]
    assert len(fixed) == 2
    found,C = find_basis_with_sparsest_coefficients(
        lyap[k],in_col,pep_context=ctx,resolve_parameters=params_sp,
        fixed_vectors=fixed,**search_tolerances)
    assert len(found) == ranks[k]
    sparse_basis_by_k[k],cached_coefficients[k] = found,C
    coeff_inputs[k] = dict(context=ctx,expression=lyap[k],parameters=dict(params_sp),
        tolerances=dict(search_tolerances),basis_ids=tuple(id(v) for v in found),
        basis_coords=np.column_stack([pm.eval_vector(v).coords for v in found]).astype(float).copy(),
        target_coords=np.asarray(pm.eval_scalar(lyap[k]).inner_prod_coords,dtype=float).copy())
    chosen_labels = [labels[id(v)] for v in found]
    zeros = int(np.sum(np.abs(C) < search_tolerances["zero_tol"]))
    sparse_search_records[k] = dict(rank=ranks[k],basis_labels=chosen_labels,
        zero_coefficients=zeros,total_coefficients=int(C.size),fixed_labels=["u",f"g_{k}/L"])
    print(f"k={k}, rank {ranks[k]}")
    print("  sparse basis:",chosen_labels)
    print(f"  zero coefficients: {zeros}/{C.size}")

"""Extract every coefficient matrix with guarded reuse and full rank checks."""

extraction_tolerances = dict(indep_tol=1e-7,span_tol=1e-5)
coeff_by_k, coefficient_residuals, coefficient_reuse = {}, {}, {}
required_indices = list(range(N_int+1))
function_label_map = {str(obj(ctx["x_star"])):"f_star"}
function_label_map.update({str(obj(ctx[f"x_{i}"])):f"f_{i}" for i in range(N_int+1)})
function_display_labels = [function_label_map[label] for label in scalar_labels]
for k in required_indices:
    vectors = basis_by_k[k]
    target = np.asarray(pm.eval_scalar(lyap[k]).inner_prod_coords,dtype=float)
    matrix = np.column_stack([pm.eval_vector(v).coords for v in vectors]).astype(float) if vectors else np.zeros((len(ctx.basis_vectors()),0))
    # Reuse the actual search vectors when the ordered template has identical
    # coordinates. This makes the subsequent identity/context cache guard real.
    searched = sparse_basis_by_k.get(k)
    if searched is not None:
        searched_matrix = np.column_stack([pm.eval_vector(v).coords for v in searched]).astype(float)
        if np.array_equal(searched_matrix,matrix):
            vectors = basis_by_k[k] = searched
    basis_rank = int(np.linalg.matrix_rank(matrix,tol=extraction_tolerances["indep_tol"])) if vectors else 0
    assert basis_rank == len(vectors) == ranks[k]
    previous = coeff_inputs.get(k)
    cached_C = cached_coefficients.get(k)
    unchanged = (previous is not None and previous["context"] is ctx
        and previous["expression"] is lyap[k] and previous["parameters"] == params_sp
        and previous["tolerances"] == search_tolerances
        and all(previous["tolerances"][name] == value for name,value in extraction_tolerances.items())
        and previous["basis_ids"] == tuple(id(v) for v in vectors)
        and np.array_equal(previous["basis_coords"],matrix)
        and np.array_equal(previous["target_coords"],target))
    reusable = (unchanged and cached_C is not None and cached_C.shape == (len(vectors),len(vectors))
        and np.all(np.isfinite(cached_C)) and np.array_equal(cached_C,cached_C.T)
        and np.linalg.norm(matrix@cached_C@matrix.T-target,ord="fro")
            <= extraction_tolerances["span_tol"]*max(1.0,np.linalg.norm(target,ord="fro")))
    C = cached_C if reusable else find_symmetric_coefficient_matrix(
        lyap[k],vectors,pep_context=ctx,resolve_parameters=params_sp,**extraction_tolerances)
    assert C.shape == (len(vectors),len(vectors)) and np.all(np.isfinite(C))
    assert np.array_equal(C,C.T)
    residual = float(np.linalg.norm(matrix@C@matrix.T-target,ord="fro"))
    assert residual <= extraction_tolerances["span_tol"]*max(1.0,np.linalg.norm(target,ord="fro"))
    coeff_by_k[k],coefficient_residuals[k],coefficient_reuse[k] = C,residual,bool(reusable)
    print(f"k={k}: quadratic reconstruction residual {residual:.3e}")
    if vectors:
        pf.pprint_labeled_matrix(C,V_k_basis_labels(k),V_k_basis_labels(k),precision=6)
    else:
        print("Empty 0-by-0 coefficient matrix.")
    value = pm.eval_scalar(lyap[k])
    pf.pprint_labeled_matrix(np.asarray(value.func_coords,dtype=float).reshape(1,-1),
        [f"F(V_{k})"],function_display_labels,precision=9)
    print("Offset:",value.offset)
assert set(coeff_by_k) == set(required_indices)
executed_sources.reconstruction_code:
"""Check Gram, function-value, and constant components for all indices."""

component_residuals = {}
for k in required_indices:
    diff = pm.eval_scalar(V_k_structure(k)-lyap[k])
    target = pm.eval_scalar(lyap[k])
    component_residuals[str(k)] = {}
    for name,residual,target_component in (
        ("gram",diff.inner_prod_coords,target.inner_prod_coords),
        ("function",diff.func_coords,target.func_coords),
        ("offset",diff.offset,target.offset)):
        residual,target_component = np.asarray(residual,dtype=float),np.asarray(target_component,dtype=float)
        error = float(np.max(np.abs(residual),initial=0))
        scale = float(np.max(np.abs(target_component),initial=0))
        assert np.all(np.isfinite(residual))
        assert error <= b3["reconstruction_tolerance"]+b3["reconstruction_rtol"]*scale,(k,name,error)
        component_residuals[str(k)][name] = error
    assert float(target.offset) == 0.0
    print(f"k={k}: full Gram/function/offset residuals",component_residuals[str(k)])
